DECLARE

 v_acceptable varchar2(1) := 'n' ;
 v_sample_type sample_checkin_conditions.sample_type%type := null ;
 v_box_id sample_checkin_conditions.box_id%type := null ;
 v_count number := 0 ;
 v_status_flag varchar2(1) := null ;
 v_sample_type_match sample_checkin_conditions.sample_type%type := null ;
 v_local_date date := null ;
 
BEGIN
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 v_local_date := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 
 first_record ; 
 loop
 
 IF :test_sample_type_match.select_flag = 'X' then 
 
 v_sample_type_match := :test_sample_type_match.sample_type ;
 exit ;
 
 end if ;
 
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 
 end loop ;
 
 if v_sample_type_match is not null then
 -- validate sample_type / test_id
 begin
 select 'y'
 into v_acceptable
 from valid_test_sample_types
 where sample_type = v_sample_type_match
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_6.test_id
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_date+1) ;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 v_acceptable := 'n';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 if v_acceptable = 'y' then
 v_status_flag := 'A';
 v_sample_type := v_sample_type_match ;
 else
 v_sample_type := v_sample_type_match ;
 v_status_flag := 'X';
 end if;
 
 update sample_checkin_conditions
 set sample_type = v_sample_type,
 status_flag = v_status_flag
 
 where insert_user = :banner.user_id
 and program_id = :banner.prog_name
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_6.test_id 
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id 
 and status_flag = 'S' ;
 
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('ctrl_blk_6');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3') ;
 
 -- Check if any more test_id's for this unit_id had multiple sample_types and handle
 
 v_count := 0 ;
 select count(*)
 into v_count
 from sample_checkin_conditions
 where insert_user = :banner.user_id
 and program_id = :banner.prog_name
 and status_flag = 'S'
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id ;
 
 if v_count > 0 then
 handle_multi_sample_types ;
 else
 
 -- no more 'S' types, check if any test_id's for this unit_id need an over-ride and handle
 
 v_count := 0 ;
 select count(*)
 into v_count
 from sample_checkin_conditions
 where insert_user = :banner.user_id
 and program_id = :banner.prog_name
 and status_flag = 'X'
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id ;
 
 if v_count > 0 then
 handle_override ;
 else 
 commit_units ;
 end if ; 
 
 end if ;
 
 else
 
 -- user must assign a sample_type
 
 go_block('test_sample_type_match');
 go_record('1');
 go_item('test_sample_type_match.select_flag');
 show_error('1402');
 check_package_failure;
 
 end if;
END;

PACKAGE BODY pkg_multiselect IS

 tabrec TAB_REC_REC;
 va_name varchar2(40) := 'VA_SELECTED_RECORD' ;
 
 ------------------------------------------
 -- colorize the current selected record --
 ------------------------------------------
 procedure color_select_record 
 (
 blockname in varchar2
 ,numrec in pls_integer 
 ,color in boolean
 )
 is
 LC$item varchar2(60);
 LC$itemdeb varchar2(60);
 LN$len pls_integer ;
 begin
 
 if va_name is null then
 return ;
 end if ; 
 
 -- get the first item of the block --
 LC$itemdeb := Get_Block_Property(blockname, FIRST_ITEM) ;
 LC$item := blockname || '.' || LC$itemdeb ;
 
 -- For every item of the current block --
 while LC$itemdeb is not null Loop
 
 if Get_Item_Property(LC$Item , ITEM_TYPE) NOT IN ('BUTTON','RADIO GROUP','DISPLAY ITEM') Then
 
 if Get_Item_Property(LC$Item , VISIBLE ) = 'TRUE' Then
 if color then
 Set_Item_Instance_Property(LC$item, numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, va_name);
 else 
 Set_Item_Instance_Property(LC$item, numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, '');
 end if ; 
 end if ;
 
 end if ;
 
 -- next item --
 LC$itemdeb := Get_Item_Property( LC$item, NEXT_NAVIGATION_ITEM );
 LC$item := blockname || '.' || LC$itemdeb ;
 
 end loop ;
 
 end;

 ------------------------------
 -- find the record in table --
 ------------------------------
 function find_record(vname in varchar2)
 return pls_integer
 is
 r pls_integer := 0;
 begin
 if tabrec.count > 0 then
 for i in tabrec.first .. tabrec.last loop
 if tabrec.exists(i) then
 if upper(tabrec(i).name) = upper(vname) then
 r := i ;
 exit ;
 end if ; 
 end if ;
 end loop; 
 end if ;
 return r;
 end;
 
 --------------------------
 -- clear the collection --
 --------------------------
 procedure clear
 Is
 r pls_integer := 0;
 n varchar2(100) := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block');
 Begin
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then
 tabrec(r).tab.delete;
 end if ;
 End;
 
 -----------------------------
 -- clear all form's blocks --
 -----------------------------
 procedure clear_all_blocks
 Is
 r pls_integer := 0;
 n varchar2(100);
 Begin
 if tabrec.count > 0 then
 for i in tabrec.first .. tabrec.last loop
 r := instr( tabrec(i).name, '.' ) ;
 n := upper(substr(tabrec(i).name, 1, r-1));
 if n = upper(name_in('system.current_form')) then
 tabrec.delete(i);
 end if ; 
 end loop; 
 end if ;
 End; 
 
 ------------------------------
 -- get the NUMREC value 0/1 --
 ------------------------------
 function get_state( numrec in pls_integer ) 
 return pls_integer
 is 
 r pls_integer := 0; 
 n varchar2(100) := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block'); 
 begin
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then 
 return tabrec(r).tab(numrec);
 end if ; 
 end;
 
 --------------------------
 -- set the NUMREC value --
 --------------------------
 procedure set_state( numrec in pls_integer, value in pls_integer )
 is
 r pls_integer := 0;
 n varchar2(100) := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block');
 begin
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then 
 tabrec(r).tab(numrec) := value ;
 else
 r := tabrec.count + 1;
 tabrec(r).name := n ;
 tabrec(r).tab(numrec) := value ;
 end if ;
 end;
 
 -----------------------------
 -- change the NUMREC value --
 -----------------------------
 procedure change_state( numrec in pls_integer )
 is
 r pls_integer := 0; 
 n varchar2(100) := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block'); 
 begin
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then 
 if tabrec(r).tab(numrec) = 0 then
 tabrec(r).tab(numrec) := 1 ;
 color_selected_record (numrec, true);
 else
 tabrec(r).tab(numrec) := 0 ;
 color_selected_record (numrec, false);
 end if ; 
 else
 message('not found: '|| n, no_acknowledge);
 end if ;
 end; 
 
 procedure color_selected_record(numrec IN PLS_INTEGER, color IN BOOLEAN) is
 begin
 if color then
 pkg_multiselect.checked_tb(:MASTER_CODES.CODE) := TRUE; 
 Set_Item_Instance_Property('MASTER_CODES.CODE', numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'VA_SELECTED_RECORD');
 Set_Item_Instance_Property('MASTER_CODES.CODE_DESC', numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'VA_SELECTED_RECORD');
 else 
 pkg_multiselect.checked_tb(:MASTER_CODES.CODE) := FALSE;
 Set_Item_Instance_Property('MASTER_CODES.CODE', numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, '');
 Set_Item_Instance_Property('MASTER_CODES.CODE_DESC', numrec, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, '');
 end if ; 
 end;
 
 -----------------------------------
 -- get the checked records list --
 -----------------------------------
 function get_checked_list(blockname in varchar2 default null)
 return TAB_CHK
 is
 tb TAB_CHK ; 
 j pls_integer := 0 ;
 r pls_integer := 0; 
 n varchar2(100) ;
 begin
 if blockname is not null then
 n := blockname ;
 else
 n := name_in('system.current_form') || '.' || Name_in('system.cursor_block'); 
 end if ; 
 r := find_record(n);
 if r > 0 then 
 if tabrec(r).tab.count > 0 Then
 for i IN tabrec(r).tab.first .. tabrec(r).tab.last loop
 if tabrec(r).tab(i) = 1 Then
 j := j + 1 ;
 tb(j) := i ;
 end if ; 
 end loop; 
 end if ;
 else
 message('not found: '|| n, no_acknowledge);
 end if ;
 return tb ;
 end;
 
 -----------------------------------
 -- set the visual attribute name --
 -----------------------------------
 procedure set_visual_attribute_name ( vaname in varchar2)
 is
 va VisualAttribute;
 begin
 va := find_va(vaname);
 if Id_Null(va) then 
 va_name := null ;
 else
 va_name := vaname ; 
 end if; 
 
 end; 
 
 ----------------------------------
 -- set the selected record's --
 -- visual attribute properties --
 ----------------------------------
 procedure set_select_visual_attributes
 (
 fontname in varchar2 default null
 ,fontsize in varchar2 default null
 ,fontweight in varchar2 default null
 ,background in varchar2 default null
 ,foreground in varchar2 default null
 )
 is
 va VisualAttribute;
 begin
 va := find_va(va_name);
 if Id_Null(va) then 
 va_name := null ;
 return; 
 end if;
 
 if fontname is not null then
 set_va_property(va, FONT_NAME, fontname);
 end if ;
 if fontsize is not null then 
 set_va_property(va, FONT_SIZE, to_number(fontsize));
 end if ; 
 if fontweight is not null then 
 set_va_property(va, FONT_WEIGHT, to_number(fontweight)); 
 end if ;
 if background is not null then 
 set_va_property(va, BACKGROUND_COLOR, background); 
 end if ; 
 if foreground is not null then 
 set_va_property(va, FOREGROUND_COLOR, foreground); 
 end if ; 
 end;
 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_UTRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE POPULATE_UTRS IS

 temp_utr_max_seq_no number;
 temp_max_seq_no number;
 temp_utb_seq_no number;
 v_ssid_count number := 0 ;
 
BEGIN
 savepoint all_clear;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 begin
 --
 -- collection date and chapter_id not present in the
 -- where clause as it might be null; note
 -- that cancel_flag is not present as the
 -- test_seq_no includes that
 --
 select max(test_seq_no)
 into temp_utr_max_seq_no
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_date),sysdate) =
 nvl(trunc(:ctrl_blk_3.coll_date),sysdate) and
 nvl(chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('2.2');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 temp_utr_max_seq_no := nvl(temp_utr_max_seq_no,0);
 temp_max_seq_no := temp_utr_max_seq_no+1;
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_id,
 test_seq_no, program_id,
 insert_dats, insert_user_id)
 values (:ctrl_blk_3.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_3.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.test_id,temp_max_seq_no,
 :banner.prog_name, sysdate,:banner.user_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in inserting in utrs');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- Check to see if verified results are already
 -- present in unit_test_base
 begin
 select min(test_seq_no)
 into temp_utb_seq_no
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_Date),sysdate) =
 nvl(trunc(:ctrl_blk_3.coll_date),sysdate) and
 nvl(chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 result_status_2 is null and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 if nvl(temp_utb_seq_no,0) = 0
 then
 -- message('Verfified result not present');
 null;
 else
 -- message('Verified result present');
 begin
 -- message('Updating utrs');
 update utrs
 set (test_state, test_mode, result_status_1,
 result_status_2, tb_id, test_chapter_id,
 tb_seq_no, well_number, absorbance,
 ratio, result_dats, result_user_id,
 testing_lab_code, program_id) =
 (select test_state, test_mode, result_status_1,
 result_status_2, tb_id, test_chapter_id,
 tb_seq_no, well_number, absorbance,
 ratio, result_dats, result_user_id,
 testing_lab_code, program_id
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_Date),sysdate) =
 nvl(trunc(:ctrl_blk_3.coll_date),sysdate) and
 nvl(chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id and
 test_seq_no = temp_utb_seq_no and
 cancel_flag is null)
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_Date),sysdate) =
 nvl(trunc(:ctrl_blk_3.coll_date),sysdate) and
 nvl(chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id and
 test_seq_no = temp_max_seq_no and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating utrs');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 begin
 -- message('Deleting from unit_test_base');
 delete from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_Date),sysdate) =
 nvl(trunc(:ctrl_blk_3.coll_date),sysdate)
 and nvl(chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,:global.chapter_id)
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id and
 test_seq_no = temp_utb_seq_no and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in deleting from unit_test base');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;

 if :global.screen_mode = 'CNFRM' then
 -- when confirmatory test's validate sample_type / test_id for unit

 select count(*)
 into v_ssid_count
 from sample_shipment_in_det
 where int_unit_id = :ctrl_blk_3.unit_id ;
 
 if v_ssid_count > 0 then
 create_scc_record; 
 else 
 commit_units ;
 end if ; 
 else 
 commit_units ;
 end if ;
 
END;
